idea-plugin.name: Cmd Widget
idea-plugin.description:
Cmd Widget is an IntelliJ Platform status bar plugin under development.
This build provides independent text widgets from saved global definitions in ordinary IDE and split mode, with frontend or backend command execution, bounded diagnostics, and stale-value markers. Configure widgets in Settings / Preferences > Tools > Cmd Widget, and explicitly test unsaved commands on the selected execution host. Global definitions are persisted and synchronized to the backend. Execution hosts: macOS and Linux.
